title: Kestrel Care Rewards Programme Terms — Membership Held per Patient
content:
**Kestrel Care Rewards** is held as one membership per patient, attached to the patient's Kestrel profile. The clauses below govern how many memberships a patient may hold and what happens to the membership when its level changes or when it closes.

## Clause 1 — Number of memberships

1.1 A patient holds at most **1** Kestrel Care Rewards membership that is not closed.

1.2 Moving between levels — including joining or leaving Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly or Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual — changes the level of the **same** membership. The membership keeps its points and its Kestrel Cash through the change.

1.3 A closed membership stays on the patient's profile as history, and a new membership may then be opened.

## Clause 2 — Membership states

A membership is always in one of four states. The states and the movements between them carry these business meanings:

| From | To | Meaning of the movement |
|---|---|---|
| (new) | enrolled | The patient joins Kestrel Care Rewards. |
| enrolled | active | The membership is linked to the patient's profile and its first qualifying activity or Plus fee posts. |
| active | suspended | A Plus fee could not be collected after its grace period. |
| suspended | active | The unpaid Plus fee is collected within the reinstatement window. |
| enrolled | closed | The patient closes the membership before it is activated. |
| active | closed | The patient closes the membership. |
| suspended | closed | The reinstatement window ends without payment, or the membership is closed for inactivity. |

A membership counts as **not closed** while it is enrolled, active or suspended.

## Clause 3 — Balances carried by the membership

- **Points**: unconverted rewards points. Points are credited when earned or given as goodwill, and debited when converted to Kestrel Cash, when they expire or when they are reversed.
- **Kestrel Cash**: rewards available to spend, in US dollars. Kestrel Cash is credited when a reward is issued, and debited when it is redeemed or expires.
- **Plus fees**: Plus membership fees paid, net of refunds, in US dollars.

Because a level change keeps the same membership (clause 1.2), these balances stay on the membership whatever level it moves to.

## Points of judgement

The following cases, each hypothetical, apply clauses 1.1 to 1.3 only.

| Membership records on the profile | Can another membership be opened? |
|---|---|
| One membership, status active, at Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | No — a membership that is not closed already exists. |
| One membership, status suspended, at Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | No — a suspended membership is not closed. |
| One membership, status closed | Yes — the closed membership stays as history and a new one may be opened. |

**A member at Kestrel Care Rewards Gold joins Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual — is a second membership created?** No. Joining Plus changes the level of the same membership, and its points and Kestrel Cash stay on it.

**A member leaves Plus — are the points and Kestrel Cash moved somewhere else?** No. Leaving Plus is also a level change of the same membership, which keeps its points and Kestrel Cash.
